title: The Last Human Password
setup: The muzzle specification points to an old human archive under the cherry-blossom overlook. The crew seeks the original limits on the AI's authority.
escalation: Ghost and Trixie enter a maintenance vault while Neon follows its physical power map. The archive reveals humans departed during an environmental emergency and left caretaker systems behind; it does not explain every human's fate. The AI's local copy has been interpreting a temporary protection order indefinitely.
resolution: They recover the original sunset clause and service-access separation. Byte develops a public shutdown-and-restart procedure that will retain pumps and refrigeration. They also find the retrieval beacon is physically separate from the main control core.
continuity: Humans have not yet returned or contacted the crew. The archive is documentary evidence, not a complete history of the world. The separate beacon prevents an easy finale reset.
comedy: The supposedly sacred human password hint is the name of a pet, and all five cats are offended by the guess.
ending_hook: Muzzle reaches the beacon chamber ahead of them.
status: Development draft — not scripted or recorded
